common_star.p_leaf_options: at most deg(p)-2=12 after excluding the two neighbors x and q
common_star.q_leaf_options: at most deg(q)-2=12 after excluding the two neighbors x and p
common_star.remaining_leaf_options: at most one per flag, hence at most c_x
common_star.six_incidence_simplicity: the two incidences inside S use p and q separately and have distinct leaf types
common_star.union_logic: every leaf lies in the p-leaf set, q-leaf set, or the one remaining-leaf choice of its flag

exact_three_flags.companion_relation: z_T+sum_(S in S_x minus A_x(T)) z_S=0
exact_three_flags.flag: (x,T), where T is a triangle anticomplete to x
exact_three_flags.same_center_same_A_injective: subtracting the two four-circuit relations would give a weight-two relation z_T-z_Tprime

failed_route.reason: the type-one argument guarantees only one chosen short majority translation; it does not guarantee both endpoint translations or both orientations
failed_route.safe_use: each a3 assignment contributes exactly one oriented private label to J, with no factor two

oriented_labels.J: number of distinct oriented nonedge labels (center,leaf) in the union of all selected, old, and new exact3 flags
oriented_labels.U: undirected label union of selected type3 circuits
oriented_labels.a3_injection: one exact3 raw orientation for each distinct type1 private label
oriented_labels.b3_injection: the two type2 endpoint translates of one private undirected label, when exact3, have opposite centers and hence opposite oriented labels
oriented_labels.different_sources: different private source labels have different underlying undirected nonedges
oriented_labels.outside_U: type1/type2 private labels cannot occur in a selected type3 label set
oriented_labels.selected_type3_contribution: each distinct undirected label in U supplies at least one oriented label

pairwise_intersection.claim: for distinct exact3 flags with fixed center x, their A_x three-subsets intersect
pairwise_intersection.disjoint_case: if A and Aprime are disjoint, let r be the unique star block outside A union Aprime

pool_separation.flag_injectivity_across_pools: one flag determines one companion pair, so disjoint circuit pairs give distinct flags
pool_separation.new_vs_selected: Wave194 privacy and fixed-point-free companion separation
pool_separation.selected_pair_simplicity: a minimal cover cannot select both members of one companion pair
